rationale.ai-review: Evaluates intrinsic and reflective AI judgments of generated-code correctness.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Calibrated confidence supports developers judging outputs and varying review intensity.
rationale.quality-debt: Empirically finds frequent incorrect, test-failing generated code across coding tasks.
rationale.metrics: Defines and evaluates reusable calibration scores measuring quality correctness.
rationale.assistive: Studies human-initiated line-level code completion suggestions.
rationale.agentic: Studies prompted function synthesis and artifact-level program repair outputs.
rationale.risk-quality: Reports correctness failures and evaluates quality-focused confidence mitigation.
rationale.method-experiment: Controlled comparisons manipulate calibration methods across models, tasks, and datasets.
